name: Net User (SA)
help: Gets user information; Linux and macOS support local POSIX accounts only.
long_help: On Windows, retrieves detailed local or domain account status, policy, group, logon, profile, and expiration information. On Linux and macOS, looks up one local POSIX account and reports its UID, primary GID, full-name/comment field, home, shell, and local groups; an empty packed username selects the effective user, and a non-empty domain or server is rejected. Windows account-state and policy fields are not available.

arguments.name: username
arguments.desc: Username to query. Required on Windows; omit on Linux or macOS to select the effective user.

arguments.name: domain
arguments.desc: Domain or server to query (defaults to local system if not specified)
